seo_title: Custom Client Portal: Automate B2B Customer Support
seo_desc: Are your clients overwhelming you on WhatsApp asking about their project? We develop custom Client Portals so they can self-manage 24/7.
author_pitch: As a Software Architect, it frustrates me to see law firms, freelancers, and small agencies losing half their workday answering emails and WhatsApp messages from clients asking for a lost file or inquiring about the status of their project. It is inefficient management that devours your margins. I build custom Client Portals and secure extranets connected to centralized databases, where your buyers can access their documents, invoices, and progress in real time, freeing your team from communicative chaos.
title: The WhatsApp hostage situation: Custom Client Portal Development for SMEs
body:
Does your phone keep ringing with clients messaging you on WhatsApp to ask you to resend an invoice, a deliverable, or to ask how their project is going?

In small agencies, consultancies, or architecture studios, manual customer service devours your productive hours. You send files by email or share a link, but the client loses it, gets frustrated, and turns to the fastest route: demanding answers via chat at any time of the day. This constant drip of interruptions breaks your team's concentration, projects a disorganized image, and prevents you from scaling healthily, since the more clients you acquire, the more your support collapses and the more overtime you must work.

The trap of Standard Shared Folders

To try to set boundaries, many freelancers force their clients to use complex task management tools or simple cloud folders with no structure. Forcing an impatient client to search for their files among generic folders with no corporate branding is the fastest way to get them to demand things over the phone again.

Our solution: Custom Client Portal (Extranet)

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we professionalize your small business's communication. As software architects, we design relational databases connected to an exclusive web portal featuring your logo, where each client has an ultra-fast private area to self-manage without depending on you.

  1. Isolated Data Structure (Multi-Tenant): We design the database architecture ensuring that each user can only access their own information (invoices, contracts, designs) under the strictest security and GDPR standards.
  2. Secure Upload and Download System: We implement file managers connected to Cloud storage where your clients can upload heavy documentation without ever collapsing your email inbox.
  3. Project Status Dashboards: We program visual dashboards connected to your internal management, so the client sees in real time what exact phase their order is in without having to ask.
  4. Automatic Notifications: The system autonomously sends an email alert every time you upload a new file or update a schedule phase, keeping the client always informed and calm.

The Real Impact on your Customer Service

  • Radical Reduction of Interruptions: You eliminate up to eighty percent of unproductive calls and text messages, giving your team back absolute concentration to execute the technical work.
  • Premium Brand Image: Your SME or studio stops looking like an improvised business and offers a digital experience on par with large consultancies, increasing trust and retention of B2B accounts.
  • Centralized Document Control: You group all information exchanges into a single database that you own, avoiding the loss of important files in endless and chaotic chat threads.
